top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs two independently reproduced achievements with clean attribution: Pd-catalyzed C-N coupling (Buchwald, Hartwig), a mechanistically understood, ligand-controlled method used for 25 years, and base editing (Liu), a defined nucleobase deamination made site-specific, evolved to act on DNA and free of double-strand breaks, already reproduced widely and used in patients. It is distinct from the 2020 CRISPR prize because the novelty is a chemical conversion, not a cut. Residual risks are the short clinical record, the Kosugi priority question and the omission of Komor, Gaudelli, Kondo and Nishida. PROTACs (P003) come next as a new chemical modality with a clear mechanism, then perovskites (P002) with firm structure-function evidence but unresolved stability, then phase separation (P004) whose in-cell evidence is largely imaging and overexpression.
